body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/48608caa58fcd031c80455b390788a8c00b18b84_0.webp)

Rediscover the magic of crafting.

Forget lifeless, gray lists. Lumina transforms your recipe book into a truly enchanted artifact, discovered deep within the world of Minecraft.

Inspired by the rich and detailed interfaces of fantasy RPGs, Lumina is more than just a tool: it's an integral part of your adventure.

Rediscover the magic of crafting.

Forget lifeless, gray lists. Lumina transforms your recipe book into a truly enchanted artifact, discovered deep within the world of Minecraft.

 

 

📥 Installation

Download the Lumina .jar file.

Place it in your /mods folder.

Open your inventory and let the magic happen!
